about: Append-only. One entry per version of the system that has made this record's official calls, oldest first. A new version is added the day it starts making the calls; no entry is ever edited or removed. 'from' is the day the version took over the official calls; 'first_call' is the number of the first call it made. A version whose rules did not change ('rules_changed': false) only changed how the alerts are worded. Calls are never re-labelled: each one keeps the version that made it. Each line summarises the matching entry of calls.json's engine_changes, which carries the full note.

versions.what_changed: The version running when this record began. v1.4 makes the same calls as v1.3 and adds separate alerts for exits and for entries.

Gold became a standing hedge, held beside the coins whenever it passes its own trend test instead of having to win a coin's place; and the money for it came from selling the weakest-ranked coins first, instead of trimming every holding.
Alert wording only: the buy and sell lines name only coins that really change hands. What the system holds, and when it trades, did not change.
Changed back: the gold hedge is paid for by trimming every holding a little, instead of selling the weakest coins first.
